source.author: cic
source.text: si rem nullam habebis, quod in buccam venerit scribito.
source.text_original: si rem nullam habebis, quod in buccam venerit scribito.
source.text_english: if you have nothing else, write whatever comes into your head.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: non enim eodem lepore dictamus, quo scribimus, quia in altero saepe stilum uertimus, iterum quae digna, legi sint, scripturi, in altero, quidquid in buccam uenerit, celeri sermone conuoluimus.
reuse.text_original: non enim eodem lepore dictamus, quo scribimus, quia in altero saepe stilum uertimus, iterum quae digna, legi sint, scripturi, in altero, quidquid in buccam uenerit, celeri sermone conuoluimus.
reuse.text_english: For we do not dictate with the same polish with which we write, since in one case we often turn the pen around, as we are about to write again only what is worthy to be read; in the other, whatever comes into our mouth we pour forth in rapid speech.
